overview: The Medford City Council met to consider the FY2024 municipal budget, hold a public hearing on special permits for a Raising Cane's restaurant, and hear public participation concerning city clerical union contract negotiations. The Council approved the FY2024 General Fund budget and approved Raising Cane's site plan while denying its request for extended operating hours.

items.title: Records and Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved the records of the June 6 and June 15, 2023 meetings and approved a Committee of the Whole report regarding budget hearings.

items.title: Public Participation on City Clerk Union Contract
items.summary: City clerical workers voiced frustration over stalled union contract negotiations and non-union pay raises, leading to debate among councilors and remarks from Chief of Staff Nina Nazarian regarding ongoing state mediation.

items.title: Medford High School Football Association Update
items.summary: Chris Murphy presented updates on community service initiatives and upcoming summer events for the Medford High School football team.

items.title: Condolence Resolution for Fred Rita
items.summary: Approved a resolution expressing condolences to the family of longtime Medford resident and youth sports volunteer Fred Rita.

items.title: Pride Month Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution recognizing June as Pride Month and affirming support for the LGBTQ+ community in Medford.

items.title: Public Hearing on Raising Cane's Special Permits and Site Plan
items.summary: Approved special permits for drive-thru use and off-street loading waivers along with site plan review for Raising Cane's at 760 Fellsway, but denied a special permit for extended hours.

items.title: Retiree Cost-of-Living Adjustment Request
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a paper from the Mayor enabling an additional 2% cost-of-living adjustment for city retirees.

items.title: Election Calendar Corrections and Saturday Early Voting
items.summary: Passed a resolution requesting the Election Commission correct dates on the 2023 election calendar and provide Saturday early voting hours.

items.title: FY2024 General Fund Budget Submission
items.summary: Approved the amended $179,604,106 FY2024 General Fund budget following extended debate on school funding, administrative transparency, and structural financial challenges.

items.title: FY2024 Water and Sewer Enterprise Fund Budget
items.summary: Approved the amended $28,965,580.75 Water and Sewer Enterprise budget, while laying on the table a proposed $500,000 transfer from retained earnings.

items.title: FY2023 Year-End Budget Transfers
items.summary: Approved $877,700 in end-of-year budget transfers across municipal accounts for FY2023.

items.title: General Stabilization Fund Proposal
items.summary: Referred a proposal to establish a General Stabilization Fund and appropriate $5,000,000 from free cash to the Committee of the Whole.
